key_points: UBS cut Citigroup's price target, signaling a bearish outlook.
Institutional investors Mn Services Vermogensbeheer and Artemis increased their holdings, indicating some confidence.
Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar sold shares, a minor negative signal from insider/politician activity.
Discussion of whether C can trade at a discount after a 238% run raises overvaluation concerns.
Citigroup's digital push and fair value focus remain ahead of Q3 earnings but lack concrete catalysts.
